native_files.origin: Two flavors of the same corpus, both downloaded from the NCBI Dogan/DISEASE page (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/CBBresearch/Dogan/DISEASE/). Same abstracts, two packagings.

Per-split distribution, training set (PubTator format with NCBI license header). 593 abstracts in the upstream file.
contents.NCBIdevelopset_corpus/NCBIdevelopset_cor: Per-split distribution, development split, PubTator format with header. 100 abstracts.
contents.NCBItestset_corpus/NCBItestset_corpus.tx: Per-split distribution, test split, PubTator format with header. 100 abstracts.
contents.NCBI_corpus/NCBI_corpus_training.txt: Combined-archive flavor, training split, PubTator format without header.

native_files.format: PubTator stand-off text. Each abstract is a block of three line types: '<PMID>|t|<title>', '<PMID>|a|<abstract>', then one tab-separated annotation line per disease mention with PMID, start, end, surface_text, type, and concept_id (MeSH 'D...' or OMIM numeric, '|'-separated for composite mentions).
native_files.relationship_to_jsonl: train/validation/test.jsonl in this folder are produced by the bigbio loading script from the upstream PubTator files. The bigbio loader emits 592 train / 100 validation / 100 test documents (one row in train is dropped vs the upstream 593-abstract file).

id: Document id, equal to the PMID. String.
document_id: PMID of the paper. Same value as `id` in this corpus.

passages.text: Passage text in a one-element list.
passages.offsets: Character span [start, end] of the passage in the concatenated document. Title starts at 0; abstract starts at len(title) + 1 (one space joins them).

entities.id: Entity id, '<PMID>_<concept_id>_<index>'. For composite mentions the concept_id segment is '|'-separated (e.g. 'D003110|D009369').
entities.type: One of: 'SpecificDisease', 'DiseaseClass', 'CompositeMention', 'Modifier'. SpecificDisease = a single specific disease (e.g. 'adenomatous polyposis coli'). DiseaseClass = a disease class or general term (e.g. 'cancer', 'tumours'). CompositeMention = one surface mention covering two or more diseases (e.g. 'colon and other cancers'). Modifier = disease term used adjectivally on another concept.
entities.text: Entity surface text in a one-element list.
entities.offsets: Character span [start, end] of the mention.
entities.normalized: List of normalized concept ids. One element per linked concept (multiple for CompositeMention). Each element is {db_name, db_id}.
entities.normalized.db_id: MeSH descriptor id (e.g. 'D012878') or OMIM numeric id (e.g. '155600').

events: Always [] for this corpus (bigbio_kb shape includes the field; NCBI Disease has no events).
relations: Always [] for this corpus. NCBI Disease is a NER + normalization corpus with no relation extraction layer.
